title: Airtxt App - App Store
excerpt: Download Airtxt by Aistardev LLC on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Airtxt.
content_html:
Dictation & meeting notes

Free · In‑App Purchases

Talk, and airtxt types clean text in any app — ums removed. On-device or cloud, your choice. Plus a bot that joins your meetings and drafts the follow-up. Free to try. airtxt turns your voice into clean, formatted text in whatever app you're using — Mail, Slack, Notes, anywhere you type. Speak, and it shows up ready to send, not a wall of "um"s and false starts. Dictation works everywhere on your phone through the airtxt keyboard. Pick on-device processing, which never leaves your phone, or cloud, which is faster on longer passages. Switch anytime. For meetings, airtxt joins your Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams call as a bot, transcribes it, and drafts a follow-up email in your own voice when it's done. What's included: - System-wide dictation via the airtxt keyboard, cleaned up automatically - On-device or cloud speech recognition, your choice - Custom vocabulary for names, acronyms, and terms your dictionary doesn't know - Meeting bot for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, with transcripts and speaker labels - Follow-up email drafts written in your own voice - Meeting history you can search later airtxt is $9.99/month for meetings and cloud dictation. A free plan covers on-device dictation with a weekly cleanup allowance — no card required to start. Your audio stays private. On-device mode never sends a recording anywhere. Cloud mode sends audio only for the seconds it takes to transcribe, then discards it. Terms of Use: https://www.airtxt.ai/terms Privacy Policy: https://www.airtxt.ai/privacy airtxt Pro and Pro+ are auto-renewable monthly subscriptions billed to your Apple ID. Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple ID account settings.
